hero.sub: Twelve levels of sculpted residences over Solmar Bay — where the skyline, the water, and your address become the same view.

about.title: Sculpted, Not Stacked.
about.body1: Meridian rises in three collections — Foundation, Crown, and Summit — each stepping back from the one below it, so every residence keeps its own uninterrupted sky.
about.body2: Structural glass curtain walls wrap a cross-braced concrete core, freeing every floor plan from interior columns. The result: full-width living rooms and terraces on every level.

tour3d.title: Select Your Perspective
tour3d.body: Drag to rotate the tower, scroll to zoom, and click any level to inspect its collection, unit count, and availability.
tour3d.hint: Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom · Click to select

residences.title: Featured Residences
residences.body: Eight residences from the Foundation, Crown, and Summit collections — filter by tier and request blueprints for any available unit.

amenities.title: Everything Above Ground Level.
amenities.body: Six dedicated floors of wellness, culinary, and work spaces — designed so residents rarely need to leave the building.

location.title: The Center of Solmar Bay
location.body: Perfectly positioned between the waterfront and the business district, Meridian keeps culture, transit, and the bay within a short walk.

contact.title: Request a Showing
contact.body: Share a few details and our residences team will follow up within one business day to arrange a private viewing.
